rulings.before: split in effect - 肖塔尔 x2 (chats/tannen.lua) and 肖塔 x4 (misc.lua, load.lua, as 肖塔王国 and 肖塔人)
rulings.row: new T.PN.PLACE row added, preferred, noting the ruling and both superseded forms
rulings.rationale: Shol-tar: syllable-final L conventionally takes 尔 (Walter=沃尔特, Albert=阿尔伯特), and the two sibling kingdoms named in the same sentence both drop their r-coda (Cornacs=科纳克, Mardrop=马卓普). The superseded 肖塔尔 inverted both conventions - deleting the L and spending its 尔 on the R
the English is 'the giant golem', an epithet rather than a title of kingship. 巨型傀儡 was already the corpus's own faithful form in an achievement line, so this aligns rather than invents
rulings.origin: raised as a b36 review finding, declined in-window because an entity name governed it, and escalated as a terminology item

rulings.rationale: 魔宗 names a school or sect that appears nowhere in the source. The artifact is a unique arcane longsword granting spellpower and spellcrit, described as Archmage Varil's preferred weapon over his staff. The corpus renders X-Blade artifacts as X之刃 (暗影之刃, 黎明之刃, 静寂之刃, 次元之刃), and the Japanese and Korean locales both render it literally
rulings.origin: same as Atamathon - a b36 finding declined in-window and escalated

substring_hazard.risk: 肖塔 is a substring of 肖塔尔; replacing the shorter form first would have produced 肖尔塔尔
substring_hazard.why_dangerous: the corruption reads plausibly and would pass every gate, since no tool checks transliteration sanity
substring_hazard.mitigation: SPEC mandated replacing 肖塔尔 first, then the remainder, with grep -oP '肖塔(?!尔)' asserting zero afterwards

authorised_test_edit.why: adding a row changes the count; this is the case that edit exists for
authorised_test_edit.contrast: the previous terminology batch modified rows without adding any, so the count should not have moved and the instruction was to stop and report rather than touch the assertion. The licence was scoped to those two numbers, with instructions to stop if any other assertion failed
